name: The Age of the Dinosaurs
description: From the recovery after the worst extinction to the asteroid that ended it all: 186 million years of giant reptiles on land, in the sea and in the air.

checkpoints.name: After the Great Dying
checkpoints.note: Life recovers from the worst mass extinction, and the first dinosaurs and sea reptiles appear in a world of one supercontinent.

checkpoints.name: Jurassic giants
checkpoints.note: Long-necked giants and armoured plant-eaters spread over the land while Allosaurus hunts them and Archaeopteryx shows the link between dinosaurs and birds.

checkpoints.name: The Cretaceous world
checkpoints.note: Flowering plants appear and new dinosaurs spread. Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops and Quetzalcoatlus live in the last stage, while huge sea reptiles rule the oceans.

checkpoints.name: The end of the dinosaurs
checkpoints.note: An asteroid strikes Mexico and the climate shifts, wiping out the dinosaurs on the land except the birds.
